learner text: 我变成了地上的堆梨一族。
quote: 堆梨一族
part p0: comment [ref p0/note] “堆梨” is a self-created word, and it is a bit ambiguous. For me, “堆梨一族” means a group of people who pile pears together, as “堆” here is usually understood as a verb. Perhaps “梨堆的一员”.
